standard.summary: Anima LLM Adapter 的独立学习率。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: A separate learning rate for the Anima LLM adapter.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

advanced.principle: Anima LLM Adapter 的独立学习率。0 = 使用全局学习率。仅在训练 LLM Adapter 时生效。

advanced_en.principle: Standalone learning rate for the Anima LLM Adapter. 0 = use the global learning rate. Only takes effect when training the LLM Adapter.
